_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Corrupted Village#000.src: Did you do what I asked? No? Check your content book.

The Corrupted Village#001.src: HEY! YOU! What are you looking at? You want to go do ya?!

The Corrupted Village#002.src: I swear if you don't leave right now, I am going to PUMMEL YOUR FACE INTO THE GROUND.

The Corrupted Village#004.src: We were performing our usual routines when suddenly an unknown explosion caused a massive cave-in at the entrance to our main mining supply area.

The Corrupted Village#005.src: Something must be done to remove the debris, we cannot easily continue our mining operations without our supplies.

The Corrupted Village#006.src: There also may be people trapped on the other side, and I would hate to lose even more miners to these catastrophes.

The Corrupted Village#007.src: Maybe we could use the Wrecking Ball to demolish the debris, but if we don't act soon...

The Corrupted Village#008.src: How to Use the Explosive-Cloaker Machine:

The Corrupted Village#010.src: - Insert explosive item into the hole of the INPUT slot of the machine.

The Corrupted Village#011.src: - Wait while the machine temporarily disables the item's explosive property.

The Corrupted Village#012.src: - Take item out of OUTPUT slot.

The Corrupted Village#013.src: - Can be very useful for disabling explosive properties of unstable ores found in caves.

The Corrupted Village#014.src: Orikal takes the materials you retrieved and puts them in a container. He mutters some words in an unknown language, and suddenly the container turns into some sort of Magical TNT.

The Corrupted Village#015.src: But what is it connected to? That's for another day. The main thing is the village is safe. Here, take this for your help.

The Corrupted Village#016.src: Speak to Orikal outside the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Corrupted Village#017.src: Go away! I know you're angry but there's nothing to gain her-
The Corrupted Village#017.dst: 저리 가! 화난 건 알지만 여기서 얻을 건 없-
The Corrupted Village#017.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#018.src: Oh, you seem calm. What are you doing here? Bit close to the portal for a soldier isn't it?
The Corrupted Village#018.dst: 아, 차분해 보이네요. 여긴 무슨 일이죠? 병사치곤 포털에 너무 가깝지 않나요?
The Corrupted Village#018.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#019.src: I see, you were sent to aid the public. Perfect.
The Corrupted Village#019.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#020.src: I am Orikal, I'm trying to stop everyone here from killing each other.
The Corrupted Village#020.dst: 난 Orikal이에요. 여기 사람들이 서로 죽이지 못하게 막는 중이죠.
The Corrupted Village#020.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#021.src: Do you see all these spikes? I believe they are the thing spreading corruption.
The Corrupted Village#021.dst: 이 가시들 보여요? 이게 타락을 퍼뜨리는 것 같아요.
The Corrupted Village#021.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#022.src: Corruption does not affect humans like other beings. It’s much much slower, more like an infection of the mind to us.
The Corrupted Village#022.dst: 타락은 인간에겐 다른 존재와 다르게 작용해요. 훨씬 느리고, 우리에겐 정신의 감염에 가깝죠.
The Corrupted Village#022.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#023.src: Could you inspect the peak of the spike in the village for me? It might give me valuable insight. Thanks!
The Corrupted Village#023.dst: 마을에 있는 가시 꼭대기를 조사해 줄래요? 중요한 단서가 될지도 몰라요. 고마워요!
The Corrupted Village#023.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#024.src: Examine the nearby corrupted spike to the northeast at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Corrupted Village#025.src: Climb the spike to see if you can find anything useful about it's existance.
The Corrupted Village#025.dst: 가시에 올라가 그 존재에 관해 쓸 만한 걸 찾을 수 있는지 보세요.

The Corrupted Village#026.src: Report back to Orikal about your observations.

The Corrupted Village#027.src: That was quick... did you find anything?
The Corrupted Village#027.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#028.src: Really, nothing? You didn't even feel anything?
The Corrupted Village#028.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#029.src: How can it be just a spike? It must be spreading corruption somehow.
The Corrupted Village#029.dst: 어떻게 그냥 가시일 수 있죠? 어떻게든 타락을 퍼뜨리고 있을 텐데.
The Corrupted Village#029.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#030.src: Then perhaps my second theory was correct. I will have to send you underground.
The Corrupted Village#030.dst: 그럼 두 번째 가설이 맞나 봐요. 당신을 지하로 보내야겠어요.
The Corrupted Village#030.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#031.src: There are old cave systems around here from the mining days. I sent two men down to excavate the spike, can you go down and help?
The Corrupted Village#031.dst: 이 근처엔 채광 시절의 오래된 동굴이 있어요. 가시를 파내라고 두 사람을 보냈는데, 내려가서 도와줄래요?
The Corrupted Village#031.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#032.src: The entrance is a little to the northeast. In fact, you should have passed it on your way to the spike.
The Corrupted Village#032.dst: 입구는 북동쪽으로 조금 가면 있어요. 사실 가시로 가는 길에 지나쳤을 거예요.
The Corrupted Village#032.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#033.src: Find the excavators inside the nearby cave to the northeast at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#033.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}], 북동쪽 근처 동굴 안에서 굴착꾼들을 찾으세요.

The Corrupted Village#034.src: Find the excavators inside the cave.

The Corrupted Village#035.src: This is insane, why are we here?! We're looking for corruption you know that right?
The Corrupted Village#035.dst: 미친 짓이야, 우리가 왜 여기 있어?! 우리 타락을 찾고 있는 거 알지?
The Corrupted Village#035.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#036.src: Calm down. All we have to do is keep digging. Besides, he did say he'd pay us a lot, so stop being mad.
The Corrupted Village#036.dst: 진정해. 계속 파기만 하면 돼. 게다가 돈 많이 준다고 했잖아, 그만 화내.
The Corrupted Village#036.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#037.src: Forget it, I don't care anymore, just prime the explosive and get clear of the blast!
The Corrupted Village#037.dst: 됐어, 이제 신경 안 써. 폭약 장전하고 폭발 범위에서 벗어나!
The Corrupted Village#037.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#038.src: Well, that did the trick. Let's take a look.
The Corrupted Village#038.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#040.src: It almost looks like a giant spike... Woah. How deep does this thing go?
The Corrupted Village#040.dst: 거대한 가시처럼 보이는데... 와. 이거 얼마나 깊이 박힌 거야?
The Corrupted Village#040.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#041.src: Well, you know what? We did our job, so honestly I don't care. Let's get out of he-
The Corrupted Village#041.dst: 있잖아, 우린 할 일 했으니 솔직히 상관없어. 여기서 나가-
The Corrupted Village#041.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#042.src: Orikal? We're done! Pay up! I want out. This place is getting to me.
The Corrupted Village#042.dst: Orikal? 다 끝났어! 돈 내놔! 난 빠질래. 이곳은 사람을 미치게 해.
The Corrupted Village#042.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#043.src: I came when I heard the explosion. I thought you'd hurt yourselves.
The Corrupted Village#043.dst: 폭발 소리 듣고 왔어요. 다친 줄 알았네요.
The Corrupted Village#043.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#044.src: Well, I'll be darned. The spike goes this far down? And it looks like it goes even deeper than this!
The Corrupted Village#044.dst: 이럴 수가. 가시가 여기까지 내려와? 게다가 더 깊이 이어지는 것 같아요!
The Corrupted Village#044.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#045.src: Well, I don't know about you, but I say we blow it to shreds! That oughta get rid of this spike!
The Corrupted Village#045.dst: 너희는 모르겠지만, 난 산산조각 내자고 하겠어! 그럼 이 가시도 없어지겠지!
The Corrupted Village#045.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#046.src: For once, I agree. I'll do it, you guys just get clear.
The Corrupted Village#046.dst: 이번만은 동의해요. 내가 할 테니 다들 물러나요.
The Corrupted Village#046.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#047.src: ...Wow, that did nothing. We're going to need something MUCH more powerful than TNT...
The Corrupted Village#047.dst: ...와, 아무 소용 없네요. TNT보다 훨씬 강한 게 필요하겠어요...
The Corrupted Village#047.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#048.src: Oh yeah? And just what would you have in mind?
The Corrupted Village#048.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#049.src: Well, it's sorta complicated. That's why I've decided to give our new friend here the job of acquiring this explosive.
The Corrupted Village#049.dst: 음, 좀 복잡해요. 그래서 그 폭약을 구하는 일은 여기 새 친구한테 맡기기로 했죠.
The Corrupted Village#049.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#050.src: Oh yeah, we were so busy with this spike, we forgot to address you! Sorry about that.
The Corrupted Village#050.dst: 아 맞다, 가시에 정신 팔려서 인사도 못 했네! 미안해.
The Corrupted Village#050.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#051.src: Well if you don't need us anymore then we'll just be on our way... WITH our money! So hand it over please.
The Corrupted Village#051.dst: 이제 우리 필요 없으면 갈게... 돈은 챙겨서! 그러니 내놔.
The Corrupted Village#051.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#052.src: Alright, fine. Here's your pay. Thank you for your help.
The Corrupted Village#052.dst: 좋아요, 알았어요. 여기 보수예요. 도와줘서 고마워요.
The Corrupted Village#052.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#053.src: Gah! That's hardly anything! I'm not even surprised. Let's just go.
The Corrupted Village#053.dst: 으! 이게 뭐야, 쥐꼬리잖아! 놀랍지도 않다. 그냥 가자.
The Corrupted Village#053.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#054.src: Anyway, come meet me back at my tent, friend. We will discuss what to do then.
The Corrupted Village#054.dst: 아무튼 친구, 내 천막으로 와요. 거기서 어떻게 할지 얘기하죠.
The Corrupted Village#054.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#055.src: Exit the cave and speak to Orikal in his tent about his plan for destroying the spike.
The Corrupted Village#055.dst: 동굴을 나와 천막에 있는 Orikal과 가시 파괴 계획에 대해 대화하세요.

The Corrupted Village#056.src: Okay. I happen to know a recipe for creating an extremely lethal magical explosive.
The Corrupted Village#056.dst: 좋아요. 마침 엄청나게 치명적인 마법 폭약 제조법을 알고 있어요.
The Corrupted Village#056.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#057.src: There are {~} main ingredients you will need to get me: [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], and a [Switch Fuse] to activate it.
The Corrupted Village#057.dst: 필요한 주재료는 {~}가지예요: [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], 그리고 작동시킬 [Switch Fuse].
The Corrupted Village#057.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#058.src: There used to be a small mining camp a little east of this town. It's abandoned now, but you should still be able to find what you need there.
The Corrupted Village#058.dst: 이 마을 동쪽에 작은 채광 야영지가 있었어요. 지금은 버려졌지만 필요한 건 찾을 수 있을 거예요.
The Corrupted Village#058.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#059.src: It's not the big ol' abandoned mines, mind you. It's a smaller camp, in fact you should be able to see it from this village.
The Corrupted Village#059.dst: 그 커다란 버려진 광산 말고요. 더 작은 야영지인데, 사실 이 마을에서도 보일 거예요.
The Corrupted Village#059.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#060.src: Best of luck! Oh, and also, try not to die please. These ingredients do indeed promote environmental hazards.
The Corrupted Village#060.dst: 행운을 빌어요! 아, 그리고 제발 죽지 마요. 이 재료들은 정말로 주변을 위험하게 만들거든요.
The Corrupted Village#060.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#061.src: Find [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], and [Switch Fuse] for the TNT at the mining camp at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#061.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 채광 야영지에서 TNT에 쓸 [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], [Switch Fuse]를 찾으세요.

The Corrupted Village#062.src: You got 'em all! Excellent, this is exactly what we need.
The Corrupted Village#062.dst: 다 구했네요! 훌륭해요, 딱 필요한 거예요.
The Corrupted Village#062.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#063.src: Alright, stand back. I have actually never made this before, so let's hope I don't cause a disaster.
The Corrupted Village#063.dst: 좋아요, 물러나요. 사실 이거 처음 만들어 보니까 사고 안 나길 빌어요.
The Corrupted Village#063.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#064.src: Phew, glad nothing tragic happened there. This should be it, now go take it back down to the spike and destroy it once and for all!
The Corrupted Village#064.dst: 휴, 끔찍한 일 없어서 다행이에요. 이거면 돼요, 가시로 가져가서 완전히 끝장내 줘요!
The Corrupted Village#064.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#065.src: Bring the explosive to the spike in the cave and use it to destroy the spike.
The Corrupted Village#065.dst: 폭약을 동굴 속 가시로 가져가 가시를 파괴하세요.

The Corrupted Village#066.src: Report to Orikal about your success.

The Corrupted Village#067.src: Oh, do you feel that? It's like a buzzing in my ears I never knew about has just vanished.
The Corrupted Village#067.dst: 아, 느껴져요? 몰랐던 귓가의 윙윙거림이 방금 사라진 것 같아요.
The Corrupted Village#067.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#068.src: I think that worked you know. It seems the power of the spike comes from the root...
The Corrupted Village#068.dst: 성공한 것 같아요. 가시의 힘은 뿌리에서 나오나 봐요...
The Corrupted Village#068.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#069.src: But what is it connected to? That's for another day. The main thing is the village is safe.
The Corrupted Village#069.dst: 그런데 뭐랑 연결된 걸까요? 그건 다음에 알아보죠. 중요한 건 마을이 안전하다는 거예요.
The Corrupted Village#069.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#070.src: Here, take this for your help. I found this potato in one of the houses around here, and I sure as heck don't want it!
The Corrupted Village#070.dst: 자, 도와준 보답이에요. 이 근처 집에서 찾은 감자인데, 난 정말 필요 없거든요!
The Corrupted Village#070.speaker: Orikal
